youtube.title: Ice Cream Khate Hi Sir Kyun Dukhne Lagta Hai? 🧠 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Ice cream khate hi achanak sir mein tez dard hota hai, par brain freeze mein aapka brain freeze nahi hota. Thanda muh ke upar wale hisse ko lagta hai, wahan ki blood vessels ek dum sikud jaati hain, phir garmi laane ke liye jhat se khul jaati hain, aur ek badi nerve alarm bhej deti hai.

Dimaag confuse ho jaata hai aur dard ko maathe mein mehsoos karta hai. Jaldi theek karne ke liye apni jeebh ko muh ke upar wale hisse se dabaiye, taaki wo garam ho jaye. Aur twist ye hai ki dimaag khud dard mehsoos hi nahi kar sakta.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
